* Package 29: 32kg

* Package 31: 50kg
* Package 32: 51kg

Each truck can carry a maximum load of 100 kg. Assign all packages to trucks using the minimum number of trucks. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total weight in any truck cannot exceed its capacity.
